answer: Continuous work ledger. Each identity's score is the running balance of verified task completions minus abandoned ones, and only accounts older than a fixed horizon can vote or transact. A clone starts at zero and must spend real labor to reach parity, while its failed attempts debit the parent account that spawned it. Fresh identities thus enter underwater, and the reef of established accounts stays closed to them until the deficit is cleared. Any operator farming a terrace of new accounts pays the full work cost for each one and still loses ground on every clone.
